title: Beyond Social Death: A Review Essay of Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson
title_zh: 超越社会性死亡：奥兰多·帕特森《奴役：过去与现在》书评
authors: Wantchekon, Leonard
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson should be required reading for any economist or economic historian interested in long-run development and growth, race, inequality, political economy, or institutional development. Patterson synthesizes decades of his cross-disciplinary scholarship into an ambitious comparative framework to understand slavery, built on two main pillars: (i) slavery as “social death”, defined as a condition of total domination, natal alienation and dishonor, and (ii) a “bundle of rights” approach that permits systematic comparison across societies and periods. This review, after summarizing the book’s central arguments, offers three critiques—the limited applicability of social death to West and Central African slavery, insufficient attention to the Transatlantic Slave Trade, and the problematic extension to “modern slavery”—and proposes a research agenda focused on agency and resilience, diasporic identity, and reparations.
abstract_zh: 奥兰多·帕特森的《奴役：过去与现在》应成为任何关注长期发展与增长、种族、不平等、政治经济学或制度发展的经济学家或经济史学家的必读书目。帕特森将其数十年的跨学科学术研究整合为一个宏大的比较框架来理解奴隶制，该框架建立在两大支柱之上：（一）奴隶制作为“社会性死亡”，即一种完全支配、出生疏离与耻辱的状态；（二）一套“权利束”方法，允许跨社会与跨时期的系统性比较。本文在总结该书核心论点后提出三点批评——社会性死亡对西非与中非奴隶制的适用性有限、对大西洋奴隶贸易的关注不足，以及将其延伸至“现代奴隶制”的问题——并提出了一个聚焦于能动性与韧性、散居身份认同及赔偿问题的研究议程。

title: Endogenous network formation with diffusion incentives
title_zh: 具有扩散激励的内生网络形成
authors: Noémie Cabau
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a non-cooperative game of network formation in which creating access to the network – for oneself and others – is a public good. Link formation therefore reflects a trade-off between the social value of links and their private cost. The paper characterizes the architecture of strict Nash networks. Strict Nash equilibria are either flat or hierarchical. Flat equilibria consist of a wheel (i.e., a directed cycle) that may or may not encompass all agents. Hierarchical equilibria are trees in which some agents act as intermediaries between otherwise disconnected groups. When the cost of link formation is sufficiently low, the exhaustive wheel is the unique equilibrium architecture and best-response dynamics converge to it with probability one. For intermediate costs, multiple equilibrium architectures coexist and can be Pareto-ranked: the exhaustive wheels dominate the non-exhaustive ones and the empty network, and trees dominate the empty network.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种网络形成的非合作博弈模型，在该模型中，为自己及他人创建网络接入具有公共品属性。因此，链接形成反映了链接的社会价值与其私人成本之间的权衡。本文刻画了严格纳什网络的架构特征。严格纳什均衡要么是扁平结构，要么是层级结构。扁平均衡由轮状结构（即有向环）构成，该结构可能包含所有参与者，也可能不包含。层级均衡则呈现树状结构，其中部分参与者充当原本互不相连群体之间的中介。当链接形成成本足够低时，全覆盖轮状结构是唯一的均衡架构，且最优反应动态以概率1收敛于此结构。在中等成本条件下，多种均衡架构并存且可进行帕累托排序：全覆盖轮状结构优于非全覆盖轮状结构及空网络，而树状结构优于空网络。

title: DP1518 A Stochastic Dynamic General Equilibrium Model for Greece
title_zh: DP1518 希腊随机动态一般均衡模型
authors: Tryphon Kollintzas, Vanghelis Vassilatos, Tryphon Kollintzas; Vanghelis Vassilatos
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In this paper we develop a stochastic dynamic general equilibrium model of the Greek economy, in the real business cycle modelling tradition. Household preferences depend on private and public consumption and leisure. Government finances its investment, consumption and transfer payments by means of a proportional income tax rate. Households buy and sell foreign assets in an international capital market and also receive transfer payments from abroad. The volatility, persistence, and co-movement properties of the business cycle component of the data generated by the model are broadly consistent with the actual behaviour of the corresponding actual data of the Greek economy, in 1960?92. We use the model to investigate the response of major macroeconomic variables to temporary and permanent changes in government policy variables, foreign transfers and the rate of return on foreign assets.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个基于实际经济周期建模传统的希腊经济随机动态一般均衡模型。家庭偏好取决于私人消费、公共消费及闲暇。政府通过比例所得税率为其投资、消费及转移支付提供资金。家庭在国际资本市场上买卖外国资产，并接收来自国外的转移支付。模型生成数据中经济周期成分的波动性、持续性及协同变动特征，与1960-1992年间希腊经济实际数据的对应表现基本一致。我们利用该模型考察了主要宏观经济变量对政府政策变量、国外转移支付及外国资产回报率的暂时性与永久性变化的响应。

title: Training AI for When Humans Will Use It
title_zh: 训练人工智能以应对人类使用场景
authors: Kevin A. Bryan, Joshua S. Gans
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: AI predicts; humans use its predictions to make decisions. These predictions are combined with human verification and analysis, queries to other statistical models, and so on. The economic value of an AI, therefore, depends on how it interacts with the surrounding decision environment. We describe the value of AI as part of this "composite experiment" where AI makes a coarse prediction of the state of the world, show what this means for optimal model training via a geometric argument, explain why optimal training can be discontinuous in economic variables, and study how heterogeneous users or monopoly model trainers affect these results. In particular, maximizing the unconditional accuracy of AI predictions is generally suboptimal.
abstract_zh: 人工智能进行预测，人类则利用这些预测进行决策。这些预测与人类的验证分析、对其他统计模型的查询等环节相结合。因此，人工智能的经济价值取决于其与周围决策环境的互动方式。我们将人工智能的价值描述为这一"复合实验"的组成部分——在该实验中，人工智能对世界状态进行粗略预测，通过几何论证阐明这对最优模型训练的意义，解释为何最优训练在经济变量中可能呈现不连续性，并研究异质性用户或垄断模型训练者如何影响这些结果。特别值得注意的是，最大化人工智能预测的无条件准确性通常并非最优选择。

title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向
authors: Zorzi, Nathan, Beraja, Martin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。

title: An Experimental Implementation of the Core
title_zh: 核心的实验实现
authors: Leng, Ailin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This study experimentally examines a non-cooperative implementation of the core. The protocol adopts a continuous-time frame, which allows a flexible coalition formation process. In the experiment, the core can be a singleton, a set of points that excludes the equal split, or an expanded set of points that includes the equal split. Meanwhile, predictions of the nucleolus and the Shapley value are also discussed for comparison. Results show that although the grand coalition is not always agreed on, the payoffs averaged across all formed coalitions are consistent with the core’s prediction in each scenario.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验考察了核心的非合作实现方式。实验协议采用连续时间框架，允许灵活的联盟形成过程。在实验中，核心可以是单点集、排除均分结果的点集，或包含均分结果的扩展点集。同时，为便于比较，还讨论了核仁解和沙普利值的预测结果。结果表明，尽管大联盟并非总能达成一致，但在每种情境下，所有已形成联盟的平均收益均与核心的预测结果一致。

title: How large current account imbalances unwind: Evidence from historical adjustment episodes
title_zh: 经常账户失衡如何消退：来自历史调整时期的证据
authors: Erik Frohm, John Hooley, Fatih Ozturk, Lukasz Rawdanowicz, Nivetha Sivakumar
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Global imbalances are back in the policy debate. This column examines 70 current account adjustment episodes across 51 economies from 1980 to 2024 to discover how large imbalances have unwound in the past. Three lessons stand out: adjustments are fairly common but slow; deficit and surplus narrowing work through different channels; and larger imbalances – especially deficits – are significantly more likely to correct.
abstract_zh: 全球失衡问题重新成为政策辩论的焦点。本文考察了1980年至2024年间51个经济体的70次经常账户调整事件，以探究过去大规模失衡是如何化解的。三个关键启示值得关注：调整虽较为常见但进程缓慢；赤字与盈余的收窄通过不同渠道实现；规模较大的失衡——尤其是赤字——更有可能得到纠正。

title: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
title_zh: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据
authors: Melis Kartal, Wieland Müller
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.
abstract_zh: 无限重复博弈理论可能因对某些博弈参数变化、玩家行动时机及沟通可能性等因素不敏感而缺乏预测力。我们提出一种新方法，通过研究无限重复囚徒困境博弈及其变体，其中合作偏好具有异质性，且战略风险源于对对手偏好的不完全信息。我们的模型在多种情境下生成丰富的比较静态预测。研究表明，与标准理论及其他现有模型不同，我们的方法能够系统性地解释包括我们新实验在内的一系列实验结果。

title: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
title_zh: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型
authors: Joshua C. C. Chan, Christian Matthes, Xuewen Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.
abstract_zh: 大型VAR模型在结构分析中日益被用作统一框架，以同时研究多种结构性冲击的影响。然而，利用符号约束和排序约束同时识别多种冲击在实际操作中面临重大挑战，以至于现有算法无法应用于此类大型VAR模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于在大型结构VAR模型中估计脉冲响应及相关指标，这些模型通过大量脉冲响应结构约束进行识别。该方法通过一个包含35个变量、超过100个符号和排序约束的VAR模型来识别8种结构性冲击，并以此为例进行说明。

title: Market Power Is Power
title_zh: 市场力量即权力
authors: Gabriele Gratton, Barton Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We argue that in market democracies firms can wield political power through a mechanism that does not rely on lobbying, campaign contributions, or persuasion. When voters cannot commit to future regulation, firms can use irreversible technological investments to reshape ex-post political incentives. We call this mechanism the political hold-up problem. We show that, in equilibrium, a firm's de facto power to avoid regulation coincides with standard measures of market power. This form of power is robust to a wide range of regulatory instruments, including bans, taxes, self-regulation, and delegation to technocrats, and limits the effectiveness of reforms targeting political influence. The political hold-up problem distorts the direction of technological progress and may increase political demand for populism and nationalization. Institutional remedies instead require commitment: supermajoritarian institutions and independent oversight of industry standards.
abstract_zh: 本文论证，在市场民主国家中，企业可通过一种不依赖游说、政治献金或说服的机制行使政治权力。当选民无法对未来监管做出承诺时，企业能够利用不可逆的技术投资重塑事后政治激励。我们将此机制称为"政治套牢问题"。研究表明，在均衡状态下，企业规避监管的事实权力与市场势力的标准度量指标相吻合。这种权力形式对包括禁令、税收、自我监管及技术官僚授权在内的广泛监管工具具有稳健性，并会限制针对政治影响力的改革效力。政治套牢问题会扭曲技术进步方向，并可能加剧对民粹主义与国有化的政治需求。制度性补救措施则需要承诺机制：超级多数制度与行业标准的独立监督。

title: Double Inertia, Taylor Rules, and Monetary Policy Gradualism
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
authors: Edmund Crawley, William Goodwin, Margaret M. Jacobson, Fabian Winkler
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In recent decades, an empirically estimated double-inertial rule fits the path of changes in the federal funds rate better than a standard inertial Taylor rule. Inertial Taylor rules aim to capture monetary policy gradualism via slow adjustments in the level of the policy rate. Double-inertial rules build on this specification by also gradually adjusting the pace of change in the policy rate. Because a double-inertial rule explains more than twice the variation of changes in the policy rate than its standard inertial counterpart, we argue that practitioners should consider a double-inertial rule when characterizing U.S. monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，实证估计的双惯性规则比标准惯性泰勒规则更能拟合联邦基金利率的变化路径。惯性泰勒规则旨在通过政策利率水平的缓慢调整来捕捉货币政策的渐进性特征。双惯性规则在此基础上进一步对政策利率变化速度进行渐进调整。由于双惯性规则对政策利率变化方差的解释力是标准惯性规则的两倍以上，我们认为实践者在描述美国货币政策时应考虑采用双惯性规则。

title: Outsourcing Agricultural Services and Risk Reduction in Smallholder Rice Farming: Evidence From China and Global Implications
title_zh: 农业服务外包与小农户水稻种植中的风险降低：来自中国的证据及全球启示
authors: Jian Zhang, Ashok K. Mishra, Gaoli Zhu, Awais Jabbar
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Smallholder farmers in developing countries face the twin challenges of improving productivity and managing agricultural risks. One emerging response is outsourcing production tasks to specialized service providers. Using plot‐level data from rice farms in Jiangsu Province, China, and an endogenous treatment‐regression model, this study examines the effects of outsourcing on yields and production risks. Results show that outsourcing increases rice yields by nearly 3%, reduces yield volatility, and lowers the probability of crop failure. These benefits arise from greater access to mechanized services, the substitution of machinery for labor, and more efficient use of inputs. However, outcomes vary by type: machinery‐intensive outsourcing reduces risk, whereas labor‐intensive outsourcing can exacerbate it in weak service markets. Gains are greatest on larger and more fertile plots, underscoring the importance of policies that support mechanization and competitive service markets.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的农户面临提升生产力和管理农业风险的双重挑战。一种新兴应对策略是将生产任务外包给专业化服务提供商。本研究利用中国江苏省水稻种植的地块层面数据，采用内生处理回归模型，考察了外包对产量和生产风险的影响。结果表明，外包使水稻产量提升近3%，降低了产量波动性，并减少了作物歉收的概率。这些效益源于机械化服务的更易获取、机械对劳动力的替代以及投入要素的更高效利用。然而，不同外包类型的效果存在差异：机械密集型外包降低了风险，而劳动密集型外包在薄弱服务市场中可能加剧风险。在面积更大、土壤更肥沃的地块上，外包效益最为显著，这凸显了支持机械化和竞争性服务市场的政策重要性。

title: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
title_zh: 土地整合、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据
authors: Kim Lan Nguyen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Land fragmentation is widely recognized as a constraint on smallholder agriculture, raising production costs, limiting mechanization, and reducing efficiency. Land consolidation programs have been introduced in many countries to address this problem, yet their economic effects depend not only on plot reconfiguration but also on institutional implementation and land market functioning. This paper examines the impacts of Vietnam's state‐led land consolidation program using six waves of household panel data (2008–2018) from two provinces where consolidation was implemented. Impacts are estimated with two‐way fixed effects and a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach that accounts for heterogeneous adoption timing. The results show that the consolidation program substantially reduced land fragmentation: the number of plots per household fell by roughly three plots, average plot size increased by about 66 percent, and the distance between plots and homesteads declined by approximately 23 percent. At the same time, administrative delays in reissuing land‐use‐right certificates temporarily reduced the share of titled and collateral‐eligible land. While households’ overall access to credit is not adversely affected, land rental markets are significantly disrupted, with both rent‐in and rent‐out declining. Such reductions in land transactions may impede efficient land reallocation and operational scale adjustment, thereby delaying investment and productivity gains from improved land structure. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of institutional implementation and complementary market functioning for realizing the benefits of land consolidation in Vietnam and other smallholder economies.
abstract_zh: 土地细碎化被广泛认为是制约小农农业的瓶颈，它提高了生产成本、限制了机械化进程并降低了生产效率。许多国家推行了土地整合计划以应对这一问题，但其经济效果不仅取决于地块重组，还依赖于制度实施和土地市场运行。本文利用越南两个实施土地整合省份的六轮农户面板数据（2008-2018年），考察了该国政府主导的土地整合计划的影响。采用双向固定效应和考虑异质性采纳时点的交错双重差分法进行效应估计。结果显示：土地整合计划显著降低了土地细碎化程度——每户地块数量减少约3块，平均地块面积增加约66%，地块与宅基地距离缩短约23%。与此同时，重新颁发土地使用权证过程中的行政延迟导致有证土地和可抵押土地比例暂时下降。虽然农户整体信贷获取未受负面影响，但土地租赁市场受到显著干扰，租入和租出行为均出现减少。这种土地交易的缩减可能阻碍土地有效再配置和经营规模调整，从而延缓因土地结构改善带来的投资和生产率提升。总体而言，研究结果凸显了制度实施与配套市场功能对越南及其他小农经济体实现土地整合效益的关键作用。
